column1: # 4 MB flash layout (all offsets 0x10000-aligned for app partitions — required
# by the ESP32 bootloader; data partitions only need 0x1000 alignment).
#   * nvs       20 KB    (Wi-Fi / BLE config — Arduino-ESP32 standard size)
#   * otadata    8 KB    (OTA slot selection — required even if no OTA used)
#   * app0     2.94 MB   (application; large enough for the full ESP32-DIV build)
#   * spiffs     1 MB    (LittleFS — backs the SDFlashAdapter shim so all
#                         "save to SD" features work without a real SD card)
